## Population trends in Grafschaft Bentheim

This page presents the age structure and long-term population trends of the Grafschaft Bentheim district and its 25 municipalities.

For the long-term time series, historical population figures up to 1970 are combined with the annual population data available from the **LSN online portal** from 1973 onwards. From 1973 onwards, only the **total population** is used.

When hovering over a data point, or **tapping a data point on a mobile device**, the **average age of the population** is also shown whenever an original value is available in the LSN table for that year. For individual municipalities, selected indicators from **BBSR INKAR** are also included where data are available for the respective year.

```{r}
#| label: kennzahlen
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Kreiszeitreihe
# -------------------------------------------------

bevoelkerung_kreis <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bevoelkerung_grafschaft_1821_2026_mit_alter.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    jahr = col_integer(),
    bevoelkerung = col_double(),
    durchschnittsalter = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  transmute(
    year = jahr,
    population = bevoelkerung,
    durchschnittsalter = durchschnittsalter
  ) |>
  arrange(year)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Gemeindereihen
#
# Historische Werte bis 1970 +
# jährliche LSN-Werte 1973–2026
# -------------------------------------------------

bevoelkerung_gemeinden <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bevoelkerung_gemeinden_1821_2026_mit_alter.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    lsn_code = col_character(),
    ags_8 = col_character(),
    year = col_integer(),
    population = col_double(),
    durchschnittsalter = col_double(),
    .default = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  arrange(
    region_name,
    year
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# BBSR-INKAR-Daten für die Gemeinden
#
# Datei: data/INKAR_BBSR.xlsx
# Tabellenblatt: Daten_lang
#
# Verwendete Indikatoren:
# - Frauenanteil
# - Einpersonenhaushalte
# - Einwohnerdichte
# -------------------------------------------------

inkar_lang <- read_excel(
  "../data/INKAR_BBSR.xlsx",
  sheet = "Daten_lang",
  col_types = c(
    "text",
    "text",
    "text",
    "numeric",
    "numeric"
  )
) |>
  transmute(
    ags_8 = Kennziffer,
    indikator = Indikator,
    year = as.integer(Jahr),
    wert = as.numeric(Wert)
  ) |>
  filter(
    nchar(ags_8) == 8,
    indikator %in% c(
      "Frauenanteil",
      "Einpersonenhaushalte",
      "Einwohnerdichte"
    )
  )


# Prüfen, ob jede Kombination aus Gemeinde, Jahr und Indikator eindeutig ist
stopifnot(
  nrow(inkar_lang) ==
    nrow(
      distinct(
        inkar_lang,
        ags_8,
        year,
        indikator
      )
    )
)


# Prüfen, ob alle 25 Gemeinden enthalten sind
stopifnot(
  n_distinct(inkar_lang$ags_8) == 25
)


# INKAR-Daten in breite Form bringen
inkar_gemeinden <- inkar_lang |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = indikator,
    values_from = wert
  ) |>
  rename(
    frauenanteil_inkar = Frauenanteil,
    einpersonenhaushalte_inkar = Einpersonenhaushalte,
    einwohnerdichte_inkar = Einwohnerdichte
  )


# INKAR-Indikatoren an die bestehende Gemeindereihe anhängen
bevoelkerung_gemeinden <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>
  left_join(
    inkar_gemeinden,
    by = c(
      "ags_8",
      "year"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    region_name,
    year
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Kennzahlen Landkreis
# -------------------------------------------------

kennzahlen_2022 <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
  filter(
    year == 2022
  ) |>
  pull(
    population
  )

kennzahlen_2025 <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
  filter(
    year == 2025
  ) |>
  pull(
    population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Prozentuale Veränderung 2022–2025
# -------------------------------------------------

veraenderung_2022_2025 <-
  100 * (
    kennzahlen_2025 /
      kennzahlen_2022 - 1
  )


trend_text <- paste0(
  ifelse(
    veraenderung_2022_2025 > 0,
    "+",
    ""
  ),
  format(
    round(
      veraenderung_2022_2025,
      1
    ),
    decimal.mark = ".",
    nsmall = 1
  ),
  " %"
)


trend_farbe <- ifelse(
  veraenderung_2022_2025 > 0,
  "#2E7D32",
  ifelse(
    veraenderung_2022_2025 < 0,
    "#C62828",
    "#666666"
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Größte Gemeinde 2025
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2025_tmp <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>
  filter(
    year == 2025
  )

groesste_gemeinde <- bev_2025_tmp[
  which.max(
    bev_2025_tmp$population
  ),
]
```

```{r}
#| label: altersstruktur-interaktiv
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Altersdaten einlesen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_interaktiv <- read_csv2(
  "../data/bev_alter_sex.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    gebietscode = col_character(),
    gebiet = col_character(),
    gebietstyp = col_character(),
    geschlecht = col_character(),
    altersgruppe = col_character(),
    altersgruppen_typ = col_character(),
    alter_von = col_double(),
    alter_bis_unter = col_double(),
    jahr = col_integer(),
    anzahl = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(
    gebietstyp %in% c("Landkreis", "Gemeinde"),
    jahr %in% 2022:2025,
    altersgruppen_typ == "Detail",
    !is.na(alter_von)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gebiet_display = ifelse(
      gebietstyp == "Landkreis",
      "Grafschaft Bentheim",
      sub(", Stadt$", "", gebiet)
    ),
    titel_gebiet = ifelse(
      gebietstyp == "Landkreis",
      "der Grafschaft Bentheim",
      gebiet_display
    ),
    altersgruppe_5j = ifelse(
      alter_von >= 85,
      "85+",
      paste0(
        floor(alter_von / 5) * 5,
        "-",
        floor(alter_von / 5) * 5 + 4
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    gebiet_display,
    titel_gebiet,
    jahr,
    geschlecht,
    altersgruppe_5j
  ) |>
  summarise(
    anzahl = if (
      any(is.na(anzahl))
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(anzahl)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Einheitliche Reihenfolge der Altersgruppen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

altersreihenfolge_interaktiv <- c(
  "0-4",
  "5-9",
  "10-14",
  "15-19",
  "20-24",
  "25-29",
  "30-34",
  "35-39",
  "40-44",
  "45-49",
  "50-54",
  "55-59",
  "60-64",
  "65-69",
  "70-74",
  "75-79",
  "80-84",
  "85+"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Männer / Frauen nebeneinander stellen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_plot <- bev_alter_interaktiv |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = geschlecht,
    values_from = anzahl
  ) |>
  rename(
    maenner = Männlich,
    frauen = Weiblich
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gesamt = ifelse(
      is.na(maenner) | is.na(frauen),
      NA_real_,
      maenner + frauen
    ),
    altersgruppe_5j = factor(
      altersgruppe_5j,
      levels = altersreihenfolge_interaktiv
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    gebiet_display,
    jahr,
    altersgruppe_5j
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Symmetrische Achsengrenze je Gebiet
# Sie bleibt über 2022-2025 gleich, damit die Jahre vergleichbar sind.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nice_axis_max <- function(x) {

  maximum <- max(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) * 1.08

  kandidaten <- c(
    50,
    100,
    200,
    400,
    500,
    800,
    1000,
    2000,
    4000,
    5000,
    8000,
    10000,
    20000
  )

  passend <- kandidaten[
    kandidaten >= maximum
  ]

  if (length(passend) > 0) {
    passend[1]
  } else {
    ceiling(maximum / 10000) * 10000
  }
}

achsen_grenzen <- bev_alter_plot |>
  group_by(
    gebiet_display
  ) |>
  summarise(
    achsen_max = nice_axis_max(
      c(
        maenner,
        frauen
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bev_alter_plot <- bev_alter_plot |>
  left_join(
    achsen_grenzen,
    by = "gebiet_display"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Datenobjekt für die clientseitigen Filter
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bev_alter_split <- split(
  bev_alter_plot,
  paste(
    bev_alter_plot$gebiet_display,
    bev_alter_plot$jahr,
    sep = "|||"
  )
)

bev_alter_lookup <- lapply(
  bev_alter_split,
  function(d) {

    d <- d[
      order(
        d$altersgruppe_5j
      ),
    ]

    list(
      gebiet = d$gebiet_display[1],
      titel_gebiet = d$titel_gebiet[1],
      jahr = d$jahr[1],
      altersgruppe = as.character(
        d$altersgruppe_5j
      ),
      maenner = unname(
        d$maenner
      ),
      frauen = unname(
        d$frauen
      ),
      gesamt = unname(
        d$gesamt
      ),
      achsen_max = d$achsen_max[1]
    )
  }
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Startansicht: Grafschaft Bentheim, 2025
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pyramide_initial <- bev_alter_plot |>
  filter(
    gebiet_display == "Grafschaft Bentheim",
    jahr == 2025
  ) |>
  arrange(
    altersgruppe_5j
  )

format_anzahl_interaktiv <- function(x) {

  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "n/a",
    scales::number(
      x,
      accuracy = 1,
      big.mark = ",",
      decimal.mark = "."
    )
  )
}

hover_initial <- paste0(
  "<b>",
  as.character(
    pyramide_initial$altersgruppe_5j
  ),
  "</b>",
  "<br><br>",
  "Population (Male): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$maenner
  ),
  "<br>",
  "Population (Female): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$frauen
  ),
  "<br>",
  "Population (Total): ",
  format_anzahl_interaktiv(
    pyramide_initial$gesamt
  )
)

achsen_max_initial <- unique(
  pyramide_initial$achsen_max
)

x_ticks_initial <- c(
  -achsen_max_initial,
  -achsen_max_initial / 2,
  0,
  achsen_max_initial / 2,
  achsen_max_initial
)

x_ticktexte_initial <- c(
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial / 2,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  "-",
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial / 2,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  ),
  scales::number(
    achsen_max_initial,
    big.mark = ",",
    decimal.mark = ".",
    accuracy = 1
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerungspyramide
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bev_alter <- plot_ly() |>

  add_bars(
    data = pyramide_initial,
    y = ~altersgruppe_5j,
    x = ~-maenner,
    orientation = "h",
    name = "Male",
    marker = list(
      color = "#073B70"
    ),
    width = 0.82,
    hovertext = hover_initial,
    hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>

  add_bars(
    data = pyramide_initial,
    y = ~altersgruppe_5j,
    x = ~frauen,
    orientation = "h",
    name = "Female",
    marker = list(
      color = "#D70A53"
    ),
    width = 0.82,
    hovertext = hover_initial,
    hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>

  layout(
    barmode = "overlay",
    bargap = 0.12,
    height = 540,
    showlegend = TRUE,
    hovermode = "closest",
    hoverdistance = 50,
    dragmode = FALSE,

    font = list(
      family = "Arial, sans-serif",
      color = "#222222"
    ),

    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      y = 1.03,
      xanchor = "center",
      yanchor = "bottom",
      font = list(
        size = 16
      )
    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title = "",
      range = c(
        -achsen_max_initial,
        achsen_max_initial
      ),
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = x_ticks_initial,
      ticktext = x_ticktexte_initial,
      tickfont = list(
        size = 13,
        color = "#666666"
      ),
      showgrid = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "#D3D3D3",
      gridwidth = 1,
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = "#1F1F1F",
      zerolinewidth = 1.4,
      showline = TRUE,
      linecolor = "#6F6F6F",
      linewidth = 1.25,
      ticks = "",
      automargin = TRUE,
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = altersreihenfolge_interaktiv,
      tickfont = list(
        size = 14,
        color = "#666666"
      ),
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showline = TRUE,
      linecolor = "#6F6F6F",
      linewidth = 1.25,
      automargin = TRUE,
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    margin = list(
      l = 88,
      r = 28,
      t = 54,
      b = 32
    ),

    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",

    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#000000",
      bordercolor = "#000000",
      font = list(
        color = "#FFFFFF",
        size = 14
      ),
      align = "left"
    )
  ) |>

  config(
    displayModeBar = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    scrollZoom = FALSE,
    doubleClick = FALSE
  )


# Datensatz für JavaScript an das Widget anhängen
p_bev_alter$x$gizData <- bev_alter_lookup


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Filterlogik und Smartphone-Anpassungen
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bev_alter <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_bev_alter,
  "
  function(el, x) {

    var dataLookup = x.gizData || {};
    var gebietSelect = document.getElementById('bev-alter-gebiet');
    var jahrButtons = Array.prototype.slice.call(
      document.querySelectorAll('.bevoelkerung-alter-jahr')
    );
    var currentYear = 2025;

    if (!gebietSelect || jahrButtons.length === 0) {
      return;
    }


    function formatDE(value) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(value)) {
        return 'n/a';
      }

      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB', {
        maximumFractionDigits: 0
      }).format(value);
    }


    function makeHover(d) {
      return d.altersgruppe.map(function(age, i) {
        return '<b>' + age + '</b>' +
          '<br><br>' +
          'Population (Male): ' + formatDE(d.maenner[i]) +
          '<br>' +
          'Population (Female): ' + formatDE(d.frauen[i]) +
          '<br>' +
          'Population (Total): ' + formatDE(d.gesamt[i]);
      });
    }


    function updatePyramid() {

      var gebiet = gebietSelect.value;
      var key = gebiet + '|||' + currentYear;
      var d = dataLookup[key];

      if (!d) {
        return;
      }

      var hover = makeHover(d);

      var maennerNegativ = d.maenner.map(function(v) {
        return v === null ? null : -v;
      });

      Plotly.restyle(
        el,
        {
          x: [maennerNegativ, d.frauen],
          y: [d.altersgruppe, d.altersgruppe],
          hovertext: [hover, hover]
        },
        [0, 1]
      );

      var max = d.achsen_max;
      var halb = max / 2;

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        {
          'xaxis.range': [-max, max],
          'xaxis.tickvals': [-max, -halb, 0, halb, max],
          'xaxis.ticktext': [
            formatDE(max),
            formatDE(halb),
            '-',
            formatDE(halb),
            formatDE(max)
          ]
        }
      );

    }


    gebietSelect.addEventListener(
      'change',
      updatePyramid
    );


    jahrButtons.forEach(function(button) {

      button.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function() {

          currentYear = Number(
            button.getAttribute('data-year')
          );

          jahrButtons.forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.remove('is-active');
          });

          button.classList.add('is-active');

          updatePyramid();
        }
      );
    });


    function isMobile() {
      return window.innerWidth <= 600;
    }


    function responsivePyramid() {

      var mobile = isMobile();

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        {
          'height': mobile ? 500 : 540,
          'margin.l': mobile ? 58 : 88,
          'margin.r': mobile ? 8 : 28,
          'margin.t': mobile ? 46 : 54,
          'margin.b': mobile ? 34 : 32,
          'yaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10.5 : 14,
          'xaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 9.5 : 13,
          'legend.font.size': mobile ? 12 : 16,
          'hoverlabel.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 14
        }
      );

      Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
    }


    el.on(
      'plotly_click',
      function(eventData) {

        if (
          !isMobile() ||
          !eventData.points ||
          !eventData.points.length
        ) {
          return;
        }

        var point = eventData.points[0];

        Plotly.Fx.hover(
          el,
          [
            {
              curveNumber: point.curveNumber,
              pointNumber: point.pointNumber
            }
          ]
        );
      }
    );


    responsivePyramid();

    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      responsivePyramid
    );
  }
  "
)


p_bev_alter
```

**Source:** Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics (LSN), population as of 31 December of each year.

## Long-term population trend

Select **Grafschaft Bentheim overall** or one of the **25 municipalities** to explore long-term population trends. Use the time-range slider to freely define the period shown. The chart automatically adjusts its axes to the selected period.

When hovering over a data point, or **tapping a data point on a mobile device**, the **average age** is also shown whenever available for the respective year. For municipalities, the **female share**, the share of **single-person households** and the **population density** are additionally displayed where available.

```{=html}
<div class="bevoelkerung-verlauf-controls">

  <div class="bevoelkerung-verlauf-gebiet">
    <label for="bev-verlauf-gebiet">Select area</label>
    <select id="bev-verlauf-gebiet" class="bevoelkerung-verlauf-select" aria-label="Select area"></select>
  </div>

  <div class="bevoelkerung-verlauf-zeitraum">
    <div class="bevoelkerung-verlauf-zeitraum-kopf">
      <label>Time range</label>
      <span id="bev-verlauf-zeitraum-label">1821 – 2026</span>
    </div>

    <div class="bevoelkerung-range-shell" aria-label="Select time range">
      <div class="bevoelkerung-range-bg"></div>
      <div id="bev-verlauf-range-active" class="bevoelkerung-range-active"></div>
      <input id="bev-verlauf-von" class="bevoelkerung-range-input" type="range" min="1821" max="2026" value="1821" step="1" aria-label="Start year">
      <input id="bev-verlauf-bis" class="bevoelkerung-range-input" type="range" min="1821" max="2026" value="2026" step="1" aria-label="End year">
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```

::: {.bevoelkerung-chart .bevoelkerung-chart-gemeinden}

```{r}
#| label: bevoelkerungsverlauf-interaktiv
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Areas: district first, followed by 25 municipalities
# -------------------------------------------------

gebiete <- c(
  "Grafschaft Bentheim overall",
  sort(
    unique(
      bevoelkerung_gemeinden$region_name
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Build plot
# -------------------------------------------------

p <- plot_ly()


for (i in seq_along(gebiete)) {

  gebiet <- gebiete[i]


  if (i == 1) {

    daten_gebiet <- bevoelkerung_kreis |>
      transmute(
        region_name = "Grafschaft Bentheim overall",
        year = year,
        population = population,
        durchschnittsalter = durchschnittsalter,
        frauenanteil_inkar = NA_real_,
        einpersonenhaushalte_inkar = NA_real_,
        einwohnerdichte_inkar = NA_real_
      )

  } else {

    daten_gebiet <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden |>
      filter(
        region_name == gebiet
      ) |>
      select(
        region_name,
        year,
        population,
        durchschnittsalter,
        frauenanteil_inkar,
        einpersonenhaushalte_inkar,
        einwohnerdichte_inkar
      )
  }


  daten_gebiet <- daten_gebiet |>
    arrange(year) |>
    mutate(

      population_label =
        scales::number(
          population,
          big.mark = ",",
          decimal.mark = ".",
          accuracy = 1
        ),

      durchschnittsalter_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(durchschnittsalter),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                durchschnittsalter,
                1
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 1,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " years"
          )
        ),

      frauenanteil_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(frauenanteil_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                frauenanteil_inkar,
                2
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " %"
          )
        ),

      einpersonenhaushalte_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einpersonenhaushalte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                einpersonenhaushalte_inkar,
                2
              ),
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " %"
          )
        ),

      einwohnerdichte_label =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einwohnerdichte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            format(
              round(
                einwohnerdichte_inkar,
                2
              ),
              big.mark = ",",
              decimal.mark = ".",
              nsmall = 2,
              trim = TRUE
            ),
            " inhabitants/km²"
          )
        ),

      durchschnittsalter_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(durchschnittsalter),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Average age (31 Dec): ",
            durchschnittsalter_label
          )
        ),

      frauenanteil_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(frauenanteil_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Female share (INKAR): ",
            frauenanteil_label
          )
        ),

      einpersonenhaushalte_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einpersonenhaushalte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Single-person households (INKAR): ",
            einpersonenhaushalte_label
          )
        ),

      einwohnerdichte_hover =
        ifelse(
          is.na(einwohnerdichte_inkar),
          "",
          paste0(
            "<br>Population density (INKAR): ",
            einwohnerdichte_label
          )
        ),

      hover_text =
        paste0(
          "<b>",
          region_name,
          "</b>",
          "<br>Year: ",
          year,
          "<br>Population: ",
          population_label,
          durchschnittsalter_hover,
          frauenanteil_hover,
          einpersonenhaushalte_hover,
          einwohnerdichte_hover
        ),

      marker_size =
        ifelse(
          year < 1973,
          7,
          4.5
        )
    )


  p <- p |>
    add_trace(
      data = daten_gebiet,
      x = ~year,
      y = ~population,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = gebiet,
      visible = i == 1,
      line = list(
        color = "#073B70",
        width = 3
      ),
      marker = list(
        color = "#073B70",
        size = daten_gebiet$marker_size,
        opacity = 0.85
      ),
      text = ~hover_text,
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
    )
}


# -------------------------------------------------
# Initial Y-axis range for the district overall
# -------------------------------------------------

initial_y <- range(
  bevoelkerung_kreis$population,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

initial_span <- diff(initial_y)

if (!is.finite(initial_span) || initial_span == 0) {
  initial_span <- max(initial_y, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.1
}

initial_pad <- initial_span * 0.08

initial_y_range <- c(
  max(0, initial_y[1] - initial_pad),
  initial_y[2] + initial_pad
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Layout
# -------------------------------------------------

p_gemeinden <- p |>
  layout(

    title = list(
      text = "<b>Grafschaft Bentheim overall</b>",
      x = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(
        size = 20
      )
    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title = "",
      range = c(1821, 2026),
      showgrid = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE,
      linecolor = "#D9D9D9",
      ticks = "outside",
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = "Population",
      range = initial_y_range,
      gridcolor = "#E9ECEF",
      zeroline = FALSE,
      linecolor = "#D9D9D9",
      fixedrange = TRUE
    ),

    showlegend = FALSE,

    hovermode = "closest",

    hoverlabel = list(
      align = "left"
    ),

    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    paper_bgcolor = "white",

    margin = list(
      t = 72,
      r = 25,
      b = 55,
      l = 90
    )
  ) |>

  config(
    displayModeBar = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    scrollZoom = FALSE,
    doubleClick = FALSE
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Gebietsauswahl + Doppel-Slider für den Time range
# -------------------------------------------------

p_gemeinden <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_gemeinden,
  "
  function(el, x) {

    var select = document.getElementById('bev-verlauf-gebiet');
    var startSlider = document.getElementById('bev-verlauf-von');
    var endSlider = document.getElementById('bev-verlauf-bis');
    var rangeLabel = document.getElementById('bev-verlauf-zeitraum-label');
    var activeRange = document.getElementById('bev-verlauf-range-active');

    if (!select || !startSlider || !endSlider || !rangeLabel || !activeRange) {
      return;
    }


    var minYear = Number(startSlider.min);
    var maxYear = Number(startSlider.max);


    /* Build selector from trace names */
    select.innerHTML = '';

    x.data.forEach(
      function(trace, index) {

        var option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = String(index);
        option.textContent = trace.name;

        if (index === 0) {
          option.selected = true;
        }

        select.appendChild(option);
      }
    );


    function currentTraceIndex() {
      return Number(select.value || 0);
    }


    function selectedYears() {

      var start = Number(startSlider.value);
      var end = Number(endSlider.value);

      return {
        start: Math.min(start, end),
        end: Math.max(start, end)
      };
    }


    function updateRangeVisual() {

      var years = selectedYears();

      rangeLabel.textContent =
        years.start + ' – ' + years.end;

      var left =
        100 * (years.start - minYear) / (maxYear - minYear);

      var right =
        100 * (maxYear - years.end) / (maxYear - minYear);

      activeRange.style.left = left + '%';
      activeRange.style.right = right + '%';
    }


    function yRangeForTrace(trace, start, end) {

      var values = [];

      for (var i = 0; i < trace.x.length; i++) {

        var year = Number(trace.x[i]);
        var value = Number(trace.y[i]);

        if (
          Number.isFinite(year) &&
          Number.isFinite(value) &&
          year >= start &&
          year <= end
        ) {
          values.push(value);
        }
      }


      /* Falls für einen sehr engen Time range kein Wert vorliegt */
      if (values.length === 0) {

        for (var j = 0; j < trace.y.length; j++) {

          var fallback = Number(trace.y[j]);

          if (Number.isFinite(fallback)) {
            values.push(fallback);
          }
        }
      }


      if (values.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }


      var minValue = Math.min.apply(null, values);
      var maxValue = Math.max.apply(null, values);
      var span = maxValue - minValue;

      if (!Number.isFinite(span) || span === 0) {
        span = Math.max(Math.abs(maxValue), 1) * 0.12;
      }

      var pad = span * 0.10;

      return [
        Math.max(0, minValue - pad),
        maxValue + pad
      ];
    }


    function updatePlot() {

      var index = currentTraceIndex();
      var trace = x.data[index];
      var years = selectedYears();

      if (!trace) {
        return;
      }


      var visible = x.data.map(
        function(_, traceIndex) {
          return traceIndex === index;
        }
      );

      var yRange = yRangeForTrace(
        trace,
        years.start,
        years.end
      );


      var layoutUpdate = {
        'title.text': '<b>' + trace.name + '</b>',
        'xaxis.range': [years.start, years.end],
        'xaxis.autorange': false
      };

      if (yRange) {
        layoutUpdate['yaxis.range'] = yRange;
        layoutUpdate['yaxis.autorange'] = false;
      }


      Plotly.update(
        el,
        {
          visible: visible
        },
        layoutUpdate
      ).then(
        function() {
          responsiveVerlauf();
        }
      );
    }


    function keepSlidersApart(changed) {

      var start = Number(startSlider.value);
      var end = Number(endSlider.value);

      if (start >= end) {

        if (changed === 'start') {
          start = Math.max(minYear, end - 1);
          startSlider.value = String(start);
        } else {
          end = Math.min(maxYear, start + 1);
          endSlider.value = String(end);
        }
      }
    }


    function responsiveVerlauf() {

      var mobile = window.innerWidth <= 600;

      Plotly.relayout(
        el,
        {
          'autosize': true,
          'margin.t': mobile ? 52 : 72,
          'margin.r': mobile ? 8 : 25,
          'margin.b': mobile ? 45 : 55,
          'margin.l': mobile ? 58 : 90,
          'title.font.size': mobile ? 16 : 20,
          'xaxis.nticks': mobile ? 5 : 9,
          'xaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10 : 12,
          'yaxis.tickfont.size': mobile ? 10 : 12,
          'yaxis.title.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 14,
          'hoverlabel.font.size': mobile ? 11 : 13
        }
      );

      Plotly.Plots.resize(el);
    }


    select.addEventListener(
      'change',
      updatePlot
    );


    startSlider.addEventListener(
      'input',
      function() {
        keepSlidersApart('start');
        updateRangeVisual();
        updatePlot();
      }
    );


    endSlider.addEventListener(
      'input',
      function() {
        keepSlidersApart('end');
        updateRangeVisual();
        updatePlot();
      }
    );


    el.on(
      'plotly_click',
      function(eventData) {

        if (
          window.innerWidth > 600 ||
          !eventData.points ||
          !eventData.points.length
        ) {
          return;
        }

        var point = eventData.points[0];

        Plotly.Fx.hover(
          el,
          [
            {
              curveNumber: point.curveNumber,
              pointNumber: point.pointNumber
            }
          ]
        );
      }
    );


    updateRangeVisual();
    updatePlot();
    responsiveVerlauf();

    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      responsiveVerlauf
    );
  }
  "
)


p_gemeinden
```

:::

<div class="small text-muted" style="margin-top:0.35rem;">
<strong>Source:</strong> Population figures: historical series up to 1970; from 1973 onwards, Lower Saxony State Office for Statistics (LSN), table Z100001G, total population, reference date 30 June. Average age: LSN, table Z100004G, all sexes, reference date 31 December. Additional municipality indicators: Federal Institute for Research on Building, Urban Affairs and Spatial Development (BBSR), INKAR.
</div>


## Data basis

The long-term series extend back to **1821**. Historical population figures are used up to and including 1970. No values are available for 1971 and 1972 in the series used here, and no values are interpolated.

From **1973** onwards, the annually available **total population** figures from LSN online table Z100001G are used for the district and all 25 municipalities. The figures refer to the **reference date of 30 June** in each year.

Sex-specific figures, cadastral area and population density from the LSN population table are not used directly for the population time series. For the interactive trend chart, however, **BBSR INKAR** population density is added as an additional hover indicator for municipalities.

The **average age** is taken from LSN online table Z100004G and refers to the total population as of **31 December** of each year. The supplied table contains values for **1970, 1975, 1980, 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005 and 2010**, followed by **annual values from 2011 to 2025**. No values are interpolated for the intervening years.

For the **25 municipalities**, three additional indicators from **BBSR INKAR** are included. They appear only in the hover information of the trend chart and only when a value is available for the respective year:

- **Female share:** annually from 1995–2023
- **Population density:** 1996, 2000, 2004 and annually from 2008–2023
- **Single-person households:** annually from 2013–2023

The INKAR data are linked to the population series using the eight-digit official municipality code. Missing INKAR values are not interpolated.


## Population change at municipality level

The map shows the percentage change in population between **2022 and 2025**. Both years are taken from the new annual LSN series and refer to the reference date of 30 June.

::: {.bevoelkerung-map-wrap}

```{r}
#| label: gemeindekarte
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerungsdaten
#
# Dieselbe neue Gemeindereihe wie oben
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_map <- bevoelkerung_gemeinden


# -------------------------------------------------
# Gemeindegrenzen einlesen
# -------------------------------------------------

grafschaft_map <- st_read(
  "../data/grafschaft_gemeinden.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerung 2022
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2022 <- bev_map |>

  filter(
    year == 2022
  ) |>

  select(
    ags_8,
    population_2022 =
      population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Bevölkerung 2025
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_2025 <- bev_map |>

  filter(
    year == 2025
  ) |>

  select(
    ags_8,
    region_name,
    population_2025 =
      population
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Jahre miteinander verbinden
# -------------------------------------------------

bev_vergleich <- bev_2025 |>

  left_join(
    bev_2022,
    by = "ags_8"
  ) |>

  mutate(

    veraenderung_abs =
      population_2025 -
        population_2022,

    veraenderung_prozent =
      100 * (
        population_2025 /
          population_2022 - 1
      )
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Mit amtlichen Gemeindegrenzen verbinden
# -------------------------------------------------

karte <- grafschaft_map |>

  left_join(
    bev_vergleich,
    by = c(
      "SCH_GEM" = "ags_8"
    )
  ) |>

  st_transform(4326)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Prüfen, ob alle 25 Gemeinden Daten haben
# -------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  nrow(karte) == 25,
  all(
    !is.na(
      karte$veraenderung_prozent
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Symmetrische Farbskala um 0
# -------------------------------------------------

max_abs <- max(
  abs(
    karte$veraenderung_prozent
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


pal <- colorNumeric(

  palette = c(
    "#C62828",
    "#FDD835",
    "#2E7D32"
  ),

  domain = c(
    -max_abs,
    max_abs
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Separate Palette für die Legende
#
# Ziel:
# positive/grüne Werte oben,
# negative/rote Werte unten
# -------------------------------------------------

pal_legende <- colorNumeric(

  palette = c(
    "#2E7D32",
    "#FDD835",
    "#C62828"
  ),

  domain = c(
    -max_abs,
    max_abs
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Popup-Texte
# -------------------------------------------------

karte <- karte |>

  mutate(

    popup = paste0(

      "<strong>",
      BEZ_GEM,
      "</strong><br>",

      "Population 2022: ",
      format(
        population_2022,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Population 2025: ",
      format(
        population_2025,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Change: ",
      ifelse(
        veraenderung_abs > 0,
        "+",
        ""
      ),

      format(
        veraenderung_abs,
        big.mark = ",",
        decimal.mark = "."
      ),

      "<br>",

      "Change in %: ",
      ifelse(
        veraenderung_prozent > 0,
        "+",
        ""
      ),

      format(
        round(
          veraenderung_prozent,
          1
        ),
        decimal.mark = ".",
        nsmall = 1
      ),

      " %"
    )
  )


# -------------------------------------------------
# Kartenausschnitt
# -------------------------------------------------

bbox <- st_bbox(
  karte
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# Karte
# -------------------------------------------------

leaflet(
  karte
) |>

  addProviderTiles(
    providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik
  ) |>

  addPolygons(

    fillColor =
      ~pal(
        veraenderung_prozent
      ),

    fillOpacity =
      0.8,

    color =
      "white",

    weight =
      1.5,

    popup =
      ~popup,

    label =
      ~BEZ_GEM,

    highlightOptions =
      highlightOptions(

        weight =
          3,

        color =
          "#333333",

        bringToFront =
          TRUE
      )
  ) |>

  addLegend(

    position =
      "bottomright",

    pal =
      pal_legende,

    values =
      ~veraenderung_prozent,

    labFormat =
      labelFormat(
        transform = function(x) -x
      ),

    title =
      "Change<br>2022–2025 (%)",

    opacity =
      0.9
  ) |>

  fitBounds(

    lng1 =
      unname(
        bbox["xmin"]
      ),

    lat1 =
      unname(
        bbox["ymin"]
      ),

    lng2 =
      unname(
        bbox["xmax"]
      ),

    lat2 =
      unname(
        bbox["ymax"]
      )
  )
```
